name: alectronic-wishlist
description: Alec's wishlist and home inventory site

scripts.sync:manual: node scripts/sync/shop.js --only-export && node scripts/sync/amazon_orders.js --only-export && node scripts/sync/pokemon_center.js --only-export
scripts.sync:wishlists: npm run sync:amazon && npm run sync:igdb && npm run sync:bgg && npm run sync:lego && npm run sync:nintendo && npm run sync:goodreads && npm run sync:playbooks && npm run sync:waterstones && npm run sync:etsy
scripts.sync:orders: npm run sync:amazon:orders && npm run sync:shop && npm run sync:pokemon && npm run sync:lego && npm run sync:nintendo
scripts.sync: npm run sync:wishlists && npm run sync:orders && npm run build
scripts.books:push: node scripts/sync/goodreads_push.js --lookup && node scripts/sync/goodreads_push.js --apply && node scripts/sync/waterstones.js --apply
